evidence.why: Initialization calls the probe; the accessor returns __AR_Size directly.
DMA alias probing computes and publishes the byte capacity.
Shows the immediate allocation/free pair and conditional second accessor call.

facts.rationale: Corrects the standing claim that initialization consumes the accessor twice unconditionally and preserves the temporary allocation/free lifetime used to observe the arena base.
facts.value: ARInit invokes __ARChecksize, whose DMA alias probes publish total byte capacity to __AR_Size. ARGetSize returns that value unchanged. In lbMemory_8001564C, Melee obtains its ARAM arena's lower boundary from ARAlloc(0x20) and immediately frees that temporary allocation. It selects the upper boundary with `(ARGetSize() > 0x01000000U) ? 0x01000000U : ARGetSize()`: one accessor call is unconditional and the second is evaluated only when the first result does not exceed 16 MiB.
